description: Least-privilege capability for the screen-capture selection overlays, one borderless window per display (labels capture-overlay-<display id>). An overlay only draws a selection and reports it: it listens for capture_state_changed so it can close itself, and calls the app-defined capture_overlay_context / capture_select / capture_cancel commands, which are not capability-gated. It deliberately EXCLUDES opener, fs, dialog, process, deep-link, updater and the asset protocol — none of which the overlay uses, and it sits over every app on screen.
